import asyncio
import os
from openfga_sdk.client import OpenFgaClient, ClientConfiguration
from openfga_sdk.client.models import ClientCheckRequest, ClientTuple
from openfga_sdk.models import RelationshipCondition

async def main():
    configuration = ClientConfiguration(
        api_url=os.environ.get("FGA_API_URL"),
        store_id=os.environ.get("FGA_STORE_ID"),
        authorization_model_id=os.environ.get("FGA_MODEL_ID"), # Optional; requests can override this.
    )
    async with OpenFgaClient(configuration) as fga_client:
        body = ClientCheckRequest(
          user="user:anne",
          relation="reader",
          object="document:budget",
        )
        options = {
        
        }
        response = await fga_client.check(body, options)

asyncio.run(main())

import os
from openfga_sdk.client import OpenFgaClient, ClientConfiguration
from openfga_sdk.client.models import ClientTuple
from openfga_sdk.client.models.list_users_request import ClientListUsersRequest
from openfga_sdk.models import RelationshipCondition, FgaObject, UserTypeFilter

    configuration = ClientConfiguration(
        api_url=os.environ.get("FGA_API_URL"),
        store_id=os.environ.get("FGA_STORE_ID"),
        authorization_model_id=os.environ.get("FGA_MODEL_ID"), # Optional; requests can override this.
    )
    async with OpenFgaClient(configuration) as fga_client:
        body = ClientListUsersRequest(
          object=FgaObject(
            type="document",
            id="budget",
          ),
          relation="reader",
          user_filters=[
            UserTypeFilter(
              type="user",
            )
          ],
        )
        options = {
        
        }

asyncio.run(main())
